content.title: Longfu88 Casino Login on Mobile and Desktop
content.label: Log in from any phone, tablet or computer

content.article: Longfu88 gives every player an account that opens with the e-mail address and the password chosen at registration. The casino is for players aged 18 or over, and this page is written for players from Malaysia. It covers login on a phone or a computer, password reset, registration, documents, account safety and support, so a registered player can sign in with e-mail and password and find help.

Log In from Any Device

The Longfu login uses one method, e-mail and password, and works in the browser of a computer, a phone or a tablet. Select Login on the site, enter the registered e-mail and password on the login screen, then complete any security check, which comes before access to the account. The casino is a mobile website, not a downloadable app, so a phone needs only a home-screen shortcut, added in two ways:

  • Android (Chrome): open the site, choose Add to Home screen in the browser menu and confirm the shortcut.
  • iOS (Safari): open the site, tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen and confirm Add.

Password Reset on a Phone

A player who forgot the password sets a new one in three steps on the phone:

  1. Choose Forgot Password on the login screen.
  2. Request a reset link using the registered e-mail.
  3. Follow the e-mailed instructions to set a new password.

A player who no longer has access to the registered mailbox should contact support.

Create an Account from Your Phone

The Longfu88 register form on a phone offers e-mail registration only, in five steps:

  1. Open the site and select Register.
  2. Enter e-mail and create a password.
  3. Confirm age and acceptance of Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.
  4. Complete the additional personal details and residential address.
  5. Select Create Account and complete any requested e-mail confirmation.

Registration requires an e-mail, a password, a legal name, a date of birth and a residential address. A player must be 18+ and of legal gambling age in the relevant jurisdiction, and may hold only one personal account.

Documents to Keep Ready

Account verification is requested before a withdrawal, during an account review, for unusual or high-value transactions and after changes to account or payment details. The documents that count are grouped by purpose:

  • Identity: passport, national identity card or driving licence.
  • Address: utility bill or bank statement.
  • Payment method: bank or card ownership evidence, or digital wallet ownership evidence.
  • Source of funds, only when requested: proof of income, bank statements or other supporting financial documents.

Documents are due up to 30 days after the request, and a complete set is normally reviewed within up to 10 days.

Account Safety on a Phone

On a phone, as on any device, the account holder is responsible for safeguarding the login credentials, which are the registered e-mail and the password. Keeping them private is the player's part of account security. The operator's part is stated in general terms: technical and organisational safeguards protect accounts, payments and personal information. Beyond that, the operator may suspend activity for verification or suspected abuse.

When the Phone Login Fails

A failed login on a phone often comes down to a typing detail, so the first check is the e-mail address as registered, the keyboard layout and caps lock. Lost passwords call for a reset link requested with the registered e-mail. If the operator suspends activity for verification or suspected abuse, an account review may delay access until verification is complete, and support helps through live chat 24/7 or by e-mail.

Support on Chat or E-mail
